6/G.goal: Explain the historical evolution of virtual reality from pre-computer precursors to the post-2016 growth phase, using its four phases and their major developments.
6/G.achieves: This provides the foundational context needed to follow the course's later treatment of XR technologies, human factors, system development, and optimization.

6/O1.goal: Explain the historical evolution of virtual reality across its four phases, their approximate time spans, and the major developments in each phase.
6/O1.achieves: This gives the learner a historical framework for understanding why later XR hardware, software, and human-factor issues take their current forms.
